Generate EXACTLY 24 columns x 8 rows, landscape about 2:1. No text or labels, no drawn grid or margins. Equal-width columns, equal-height rows. Each object independently centered in its cell at same fixed anchor, no sprites crossing cell borders. All 192 cells required, each with a distinct actual articulation/transformation pose. Detailed painted non-pixel overhead/three-quarter sci-fi game art.

Row1 N north BACK VIEW pointing away/up; rear machinery/back/spine not face/cab/big maw front.
Row2 NE away/up-right rear-right three-quarter.
Row3 E rightward true right-side profile.
Row4 SE down-right front-right.
Row5 S down/front VIEW facing viewer.
Row6 SW down-left front-left.
Row7 W leftward true left-side profile.
Row8 NW away/up-left rear-left.
NEVER copy front views into rear rows. Do not mirror asymmetric hardware.
